item.title: Man found naked at Mardi Gras Casino accused of murdering his father in McDowell County
item.description: NITRO, W.Va. (WOWK/WVNS) — A man wanted in connection to a murder in McDowell County is in custody in Kanawha County. McDowell County Sheriff James Muncy said Sunday that charges were expected to be filed against Thomas Lawson on Monday. item.title: Deadlines approaching for West Virginia scholarship programs
item.description: For application assistance, families can call the state's financial aid hotline at 877-987-7664. Students can also sign up for West Virginia's text-message college counseling program, "Txt 4 Success."

item.title: Brooks & Dunn coming to West Virginia in 2026
item.description: The Charleston Coliseum and Convention Center announced Tuesday that Brooks & Dunn's "Neon Moon Tour" will make a stop at the Coliseum on Friday, Sept. 18. Coliseum officials say tickets go on sale Friday, Feb. 27.

item.title: City of Bridgeport approves road maintenance changes
item.description: The city already performs maintenance on several roads, including many in neighborhoods and residential areas. Maintenance such as snow and ice removal, as well as pothole patching, are needed on many of them, especially with the winter weather.

item.title: Fairmont State to release economic development study on its impact
item.description: This Thursday, Feb. 26, marks the university's annual day of giving, a 24-hour fundraising event, with this year's goal being $800,000. You can learn more about Fairmont State University's Day of Giving and upcoming events through its website.

item.title: Canaan Valley offering ski discounts on Tuesdays for food donations
item.description: After collecting the donations, the ski resort then distributes the items to a local food pantry in Tucker County. Moody believes that this project aligns with the service-oriented mission of the resort and state park.

item.title: West Virginia EMS seeks funding, recruits new generation
item.description: With House Bill 5168, which would guarantee EMS funding statewide, getting unanimously approved by the House of Delegates on Monday, EMS agencies across the state are hopeful that with the potential passing of the bill, along with programs such as the Citizens' Academy, departments statewide will begin to see an increase in funding and recruitment.

item.title: Lumberport man still in search of kidney
item.description: Since the original story, Beverly has been hospitalized three times and has had many days when he can’t even get out of bed. Beverly has had 11 people volunteer to donate a kidney, but none were viable donors. Still, Beverly says he does his best to maintain a positive attitude.

item.title: Sarah Beckstrom's parents to attend State of the Union
item.description: The White House confirmed to ABC that Trump will be bringing Beckstrom's parents to the address, which is set to begin at 9 p.m. on Tuesday.
